descriptionEn:
Commercial unit for sale with an area of 177.37 m², located on Rruga Dardania, Fushë Kosovë.
Built by Model Slovenia.
The unit has direct road access and has an open interior space, on the ground floor.
It comes with an ownership certificate and the contract is signed at the notary.
The unit is located in a well-developed area, near all the services needed for running business activities.
The unit has an active lease with a long-term contract, and offers the option of payment in instalments.
